properties.notes: Development at the site has been started but work has stopped and the developer is no longer on site. The owner of the site has previously suggested that work will recommence once the economic circumstances improve. The site has been stalled for 10 years. Site is still suitable for housing development and may come forward in the future. No Building Control records available. The owner has returned the Housing Land Survey form and indicated that they intend to complete the work within 2-5 years.. Erection of 6 two-storey houses in three blocks
